prompts.A-campus-v1: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished edge-to-edge 16:9 landscape AI concept screen for a 3D architectural dashboard titled “高新区数字楼宇”, secondary “武汉 · 光谷”, visible badge “示范园区 · 演示数据”. FICTIONAL campus for investment promotion and leadership briefing, not geographic reconstruction. Campus identity: 8 buildings around a central landscaped pedestrian court on rectangular parcel; rear 3 business towers; side and foreground 5 lower research buildings. Landmark A1 at rear-left: 24-storey slender rectangular glass tower, stepped 3-level podium, bronze vertical fins on its right facade, recessed planted roof. Real architecture: mullions, terraces, slab edges, trees, paths and entry plazas. No Wuhan monuments. Only campus demo KPIs: 8 栋 (楼宇总数), 24 万㎡ (建筑面积), 84% (出租率), 216 家 (入驻企业). A1-specific KPIs: 24 层, 4.8 万㎡, 90%, 42 家. Minimal crisp Chinese, no long paragraphs. Emphasize architectural spatial hierarchy and excellent distant readability. No sci-fi HUD, holograms, giant neon rings, circuit borders, live status, alarm/video/energy modules or room/floor interiors. Variant A campus overview, compact tag “A · 园区总览”. Ink-navy #081522 background, solid smoked blue glass, pale silver mullions, warm white windows, restrained cyan-green focus. Photoreal architectural maquette at dusk, 40 degree downward elevated oblique camera, entire campus fits frame. Model must be tangible with fine crafted facades, not transparent blue boxes. Layout: title header, four campus KPI tiles on top, large center scene about 62% width, narrow left rail “产业构成” horizontal bars and “楼宇资源” list, narrow right rail “重点楼宇” with A1 resource card. A1 softly outlined cyan and labeled “A1 科创大厦”. Bottom quiet tabs “园区总览” and “重点楼宇”. Generous negative space, thin separators and immaculate civic exhibition typography.
